newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France drains one bln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France drains one bln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France drained one billion francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 42.1 billion francs in new liquidity, one billion less than the 43.1 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on April 4.
Because of the Easter Monday holiday, the regular repo tender will instead be held on Tuesday and be a same-day tender.
The Bank of France said it allocated 12.6 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.5 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 29.5 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 12.5 percent of this demand.
